import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeSeedUniv

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option quotPrecheck false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace Probe

open AlgebraicGeometry AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))}
variable {π : C.left ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.P1 k} [AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite π]
variable [AlgebraicGeometry.SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
    (C.left ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))] [AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegral C.left]
  [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
  [AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
  [AlgebraicGeometry.IsDominant π]
variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
variable (hπ : π ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.P1.structureMap k =
  C.left ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
variable (g r₁ r₂ : ℕ)
variable (b₁ : Module.Basis (Fin r₁) k
  ↥(divisorSections k
    (AlgebraicGeometry.windowM_choice π hπ g • AlgebraicGeometry.fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤))
variable (b₂ : Module.Basis (Fin r₂) k
  ↥(divisorSections k
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.windowS_choice π hπ g • AlgebraicGeometry.fiberWeilDivisor π)
      + (AlgebraicGeometry.windowM_choice π hπ g • AlgebraicGeometry.fiberWeilDivisor π)) ⊤))
variable (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J)

local notation "K₁" => ↥(AlgebraicGeometry.divUniversalFstWindow
  C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule

noncomputable abbrev Source : Type u := Fin (Module.finrank k
  ↥(divisorSections k
    (AlgebraicGeometry.windowS_choice π hπ g • AlgebraicGeometry.fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) → K₁

#check Source
#check @Source

noncomputable example : AddCommMonoid (Source hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) := by infer_instance

end Probe
